content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the WCD Odisha Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 08-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of WCD Odisha to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the WCD Odisha Anganwadi Worker posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the WCD Odisha Anganwadi Worker recruitment is 08 September 2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Anganwadi Worker posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Anganwadi Worker positions by the Women and Child Development Department Odisha.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the WCD Odisha Anganwadi Worker recruitment is strictly online. Candidates need to visit the official website to fill out and submit their applications.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for the WCD Odisha recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for any category of candidates applying for the Anganwadi Worker posts in WCD Odisha. The application is free of cost.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Anganwadi Worker and Helper posts includes Document Verification and the preparation of a Merit List based on the verified documents.

faq.question: Q6. Where can I find the official notification for WCD Odisha Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF for the WCD Odisha Recruitment 2026 can be downloaded from the Important Links section of this article. It contains all the detailed information about the recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the official website for WCD Odisha recruitment?
faq.answer: The official website for WCD Odisha recruitment is http://engagement-awc.odisha.gov.in. You can visit this site for more information and to apply online.

faq.question: Q8. What are the important dates for this recruitment drive?
faq.answer: The notification date was 28 January 2025, and the last date for online application submission is 08 September 2026. Candidates should note these dates carefully.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for the Anganwadi Worker and Helper positions?
faq.answer: The positions of Anganwadi Worker and Helper are on a contractual basis. This means the employment is for a fixed term as per the department's policy.

faq.question: Q10. What qualifications are required for the Anganwadi Worker and Helper posts?
faq.answer: The qualification required for the Anganwadi Worker and Helper posts is as per the norms set by the department. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for specific educational requirements.
